rationale.consistency: Mirrors existing special-case handling in evaluateGlobalOptionsBlock (servers/log/default_bind), reuses the existingVal pattern, error strings match; gofmt-clean style.
rationale.edge_cases: Invalid order errors out with local state discarded; chained order options build on prior value; plugin-registered order still visible via directiveOrder clone. A Helper built outside Setup gets nil order and buildSubroute would reject every directive; no fallback.
rationale.scope: Removing named_routes/named_route_invokes from the options map is beyond the literal ask but needed for the shared-map concurrent case since extractNamedRoutes always wrote there; leftover configuredNamedRoutes alias is a small smell.
rationale.readability: Clear comments explaining why order stays out of the options map; but serversFromPairings now takes seven params and extractNamedRoutes returns four values.
rationale.robustness: No writes to directiveOrder or the options map for order; first-order-option clones the shared slice before DeleteFunc; type assertions checked. Missing nil-order fallback in buildSubroute/sortRoutes.
rationale.maintainability: Explicit per-adaptation state threading is the right direction, but the stringly "order" special case plus parseOptOrder's reliance on existingVal type form a two-place contract, and the widening signatures suggest a context struct would age better.
